# Repo Creator 1.4.2 Beta - README & Project Setup Improvements

This beta improves generated documentation, project naming and technology stack selection.

### What's New

- **Cleaner READMEs** — Empty sections and placeholder comments are omitted. Known project details, selected technologies and licence information provide useful content without invented setup instructions.
- **README Customisation** — Keep section choices and custom Markdown, preview the exact generated file, and optionally include a small “Created with Repo Creator” footer.
- **Natural Project Names** — Enter `My Amazing Project` and review `my-amazing-project` before creation. Documentation keeps the readable title while local folders and GitHub repositories use the same normalised name.
- **Reliable Stack Switching** — Changing technology stacks replaces the previous preset's contributions while preserving manually added technologies and custom labels, including after saving or undoing a preset change.

### Installation

Download the Windows x64 or matching macOS package under **Assets**. Users of v1.4.1 installed packages can select **Beta** in **Settings → Updates** to receive this release after publication and feed verification. Users of v1.4.0 and earlier must upgrade manually. Windows portable ZIP copies require manual replacement; extract the entire archive before opening the app.

Updater packages are cryptographically signed and were verified during release preparation. Windows installers remain unsigned at the operating-system level. macOS builds are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. Physical Mac launch and end-to-end installer update/restart remain unverified for this beta.

**Known issue:** The main window header still displays `1.4.1`. Settings → Updates and package metadata report the actual version, `1.4.2`.

See [installation guidance](https://github.com/DefinitivedCode/RepoCreator/blob/v1.4.2/docs/getting-started.md), [Mac guidance](https://github.com/DefinitivedCode/RepoCreator/blob/v1.4.2/docs/macOS-testing.md) and `SHA256SUMS.txt` for downloads. [Report an issue](https://github.com/DefinitivedCode/RepoCreator/issues).
